CaseCreate.description: Only visible regional targets or targets in existing work/chat may be reported. Reports are private to the author and authorized staff; evidence files must already be clean.

SupportCreate.description: Optional first message is committed atomically with the thread. Linked order must belong to the customer or assigned executor in the same country. Attachments must be clean chat uploads; text is required with attachments.

budget_amount.description: Legacy flat minor-unit amount; use budget for new clients.

expected_target_version.description: Current material version from the audited case detail; required for content mutations.

public_reason.description: Explanation to the subject without private reporter details.

age_confirmed.description: Explicit declaration of being 18 or older, attached to the terms agreement. This is not identity or age verification.

BearerAuth.description: Opaque access token. Staff sessions additionally require verified MFA.
